EXTERNAL DATASET VALIDATION

Source: HouseLayout3D scene 2t7WUuJeko7
https://huggingface.co/datasets/houselayout3d/HouseLayout3D
License of this annotation release: MIT
Underlying scans: Matterport3D. Those RGB-D frames are not in the Hugging Face release and are not redistributed here.

This file is not laser or tape ground truth.
It does not replace the company physical benchmark.
Room ids are floor polygons from the CAD release, not Matterport region ids.
Door links are derived by stepping along the published door normal.
Assessment gates stay blocked until a tape survey exists.

Rebuild:
python -m datasets.houselayout3d_adapter --scene datasets/_inspect/houselayout3d/2t7WUuJeko7 --out benchmarks/external/houselayout3d_2t7WUuJeko7/ground_truth.json
